dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: One moment... Ah, yes. There's Cosanzeana. I think she's been concerned about her inability to grow flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Not that I know anything about flowers. I've tried to help her, but to no avail...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Would you know something about that?
